description: Find artists, cultures, and organizations in the Art Institute of Chicago collection by name, or fetch them by id. Each result carries life dates, agent type, alternate names, how many of the museum's artworks credit them, and up to three of their works, the museum's highlighted works first. Pass an id to artic_search_artworks as artist_id to browse all of their works.

artists_only.description: Query mode: only agents the museum records as artists. Set false to include donors, funds, and organizations.

born_from.description: Query mode: earliest birth year, negative for BCE.

born_to.description: Query mode: latest birth year, negative for BCE.

ids.description: Agent ids to fetch (up to 25), such as an artwork's artist_id, as an array or a comma-separated string. Pass query or ids, not both; the other filters and page apply to query only.

page.description: Query mode: page to return (1-based); page times limit may not exceed 1,000.

query.description: Name to find, matched against names and alternate names; every word must match. Pass query or ids, not both.

name: artic_search_artists

artists.description: Matching agents: in relevance order for a name search, in request order for ids.

agent_type.description: Kind of agent as the museum records it, such as a person or an organization.

alt_names.description: Other names and spellings the museum records.

artwork_count.description: Artworks in the collection crediting this agent (0 when none); absent only when counts could not be loaded.

biography.description: Biography the museum wrote; present for about 1% of agents.

birth_year.description: Birth year, negative for BCE; omitted when unknown or implausible.

death_year.description: Death year, negative for BCE; omitted when unknown or implausible.

id.description: Agent id; pass as artist_id to artic_search_artworks.

is_artist.description: True when the museum records the agent as an artist; false for donors, funds, and organizations.

name.description: Name as the museum catalogues it; empty when the museum lists none.

sample_works.description: Up to three of the agent's artworks, the museum's highlighted works first; absent only when counts could not be loaded.

date_display.description: Date as the museum displays it.

title.description: Title as catalogued; empty when the museum lists none.

sort_name.description: Name in sort order, such as surname first.

artists_only_applied.description: Whether results were limited to artists; always false when ids were passed, since every requested agent is returned.

cap.description: The limit applied to this page, or the number of ids requested.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `query_or_ids_required`: Neither query nor ids was given. `query_and_ids_conflict`: Both query and ids were given. `invalid_year_range`: born_from is later than born_to. `page_beyond_window`: page times limit exceeds 1,000, past the reachable search window. `rate_limited`: The Art Institute API throttled this server and retries ran out, or the shared request queue could not start the call in time. `request_blocked`: The Art Institute API's firewall blocked the request, as it does for markup or script-like text and for bursts of traffic. `upstream_rejected_query`: The Art Institute API rejected a request this server built from valid inputs. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: True when more matches exist beyond this page.

license_text.description: License statement from the API for this data, verbatim.

missing_ids.description: Requested ids with no agent, in request order; present when ids were passed.

next_page.description: Page to request next; absent when nothing remains or the next page would pass the first 1,000 matches.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, ids were missing, more pages exist, the reachable window is exhausted, or artwork counts could not be loaded.

page.description: Page returned (1-based); always 1 when ids were passed.

totalCount.description: Matches for the query and filters before paging, or agents found for ids.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist beyond this page.

title: Search artists
